scope: Isolated local Docker workspace generation query phase; not end-to-end AgentRun, model latency, or snapshot upload throughput.

earlierOneShotBaseline.harness: Same-host PowerShell process timing of the actual one-shot Docker helper, recorded earlier in this repair.

obsoletePreGuardRpc.note: Superseded by the final quiescence-guard measurement; not the final implementation result.

mmapRegression.stimulus: A uid10001 background ctypes MAP_SHARED writer survives the same timeout/bash foreground wrapper, closes its original file descriptor, writes A->B via memset+msync, and keeps the mapping alive.

beforeMappedWrite.diagnostic: workspace has active agent processes; collect must quiesce them

afterMappedWrite.diagnostic: workspace has active agent processes; collect must quiesce them

mmapRegression.fallback: Unknown forces the existing snapshot collect path, which quiesces agent processes as uid10001; an unchanged descriptor can still reuse the previous snapshot without staging. No extra capability or per-query Docker process is added.

rpcReproduction.containerSetup: Start an isolated execution image with workspace-watch, /mnt/data and /run/centaeris tmpfs, and no active uid10001 processes.

cleanup: Both temporary mmap probe and RPC benchmark containers were removed. No existing service or user data was modified.
